title: Updated prices show old value after product update
description: Prices changed via the bulk import still display the previous value until the cache expires. Invalidation only runs for the single-product endpoint.

comments.author: Marcus Lee
comments.content: Root cause confirmed: bulk path skipped invalidation.

resolution: Bulk import now deletes catalog:{product_id} keys. Catalog TTL lowered from 300 to 120 seconds as an interim safeguard (CONV-003).
